_game: COOM: Pitfall (Doom continual-RL suite; own scenario, not stock ViZDoom)
_note: Needs TTomilin/COOM cloned into external/coom at the commit the README pins (README 'External checkouts') -- the coom backend reads its conf.cfg/.wad scenario assets directly, it does not pip install the COOM package (which pins a conflicting gymnasium version).
_keys_note: COOM's Discrete(12) action table (turn x move x execute): 0=noop, 1=execute, 2=forward, 3=forward+execute, 4=turn right, 6=turn right+forward, 8=turn left, 10=turn left+forward. For pitfall the 4th ('execute') button is JUMP, on SPACE below; the no-key entry is "": 0. Keep the instructions' Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

instructions.title: Pitfall
text: Cross the corridor without falling into a pit.
The floor layout is randomized every episode.
